title: Anote Coding Task Record
description: Schema for a single dataset record built from a Terminal-Bench v4.0.0 task by src/build_dataset.py.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the task, matching its folder name in the source repo.

instruction.description: The task prompt from instruction.md, with the harbor-canary comment removed.

metadata.description: Descriptive info about the task, from task.toml [metadata].

difficulty.description: Terminal-Bench v4 has no difficulty label, so this is derived from expert_time_estimate_hours: <=2h easy, <=6h medium, else hard. These cutoffs are our choice.

expert_time_estimate_hours.description: How long the task author estimates an expert would take.

solution_language.description: Main language of the reference solution (the one with the most code), e.g. 'python'.

solution.description: The reference solution as {file path: contents}. Only the files solve.sh runs or copies in (falls back to all code files under solution/ if it names none). This is what model outputs get scored against.

tests.description: The task's test code as {file path: contents}, from tests/ (test.sh launcher excluded). Not run by us since evaluation is static, kept as context.
